create_color_from_hex: create a Color instance from a hex string like '#ff00ff' using Color.from_hex
build_color_palette_from_hex_list: build a ColorPalette from a list of hex color strings using ColorPalette.from_hex
get_farthest_color_from_image_array: get the farthest color from a numpy image array using ColorPalette.find_farthest_color
draw_mask_with_rle_on_ax: draw a segmentation mask from an RLE-encoded mask on a matplotlib axes using draw_mask
convert_rgb_to_hex: convert an RGB tuple like (255, 0, 255) to a hex color string using rgb_to_hex
